Inside every titleThe standard

Made to be read, not scrolled past.

Each guide and book is built the same way, so once you have read one you know exactly what the next one gives you.

  • Filed by place

    One country, one state, one title. No sprawling regions and no padding.

  • Plain language

    The listing tells you what is inside before you decide, and the writing reads the same way.

  • Instant download

    Pay with Stripe and your download is ready straight away, with a receipt in your inbox.

  • Secure by design

    Payments are handled by Stripe. Your card details never touch this site.

How it worksThree steps

Simple by design, from search to checkout.

The collection is one directory. Find the place, read what is inside, and pay once.

  1. Find the place

    Search by country, state, or title, or filter the collection to guides or books.

  2. Buy, or add to cart

    Buy a title straight away, or keep a few in your cart while you compare what each one covers.

  3. Pay once with Stripe

    Card, Apple Pay, or Google Pay in one secure Stripe checkout. Then download and start reading.

Marufi Digital is an independent publisher of digital guides and books. Payments are processed by Stripe.

QuestionsBefore you buy

Good to know before checkout.

Short answers about how buying works. Anything else, ask by email from the footer.

How do I receive my purchase?

Pay through Stripe's secure checkout. As soon as payment clears you are brought to a confirmation page with your download, and Stripe emails your receipt.

What does the cart do?

The cart keeps the titles you choose on this device so you can compare them, then pays for all of them in one Stripe checkout.

Which payment methods can I use?

Major credit and debit cards, plus Apple Pay and Google Pay where your device supports them. Stripe handles the payment from start to finish.

Do I need an account?

No. Browse, search, and fill your cart freely. Stripe only asks for your email and payment details at checkout.
